verb_types.strong_B: Triliteral with a-vowel in present stem, e.g. ባረከ.
verb_types.weak_initial: First radical is weak, e.g. ኀደገ, አዘዘ.
verb_types.weak_middle: Second radical is w/y, e.g. ሠይመ, ዐወቀ, ከወነ.
verb_types.weak_final: Third radical is w/y, e.g. ሀለወ.
verb_types.irregular: Suppletive or highly irregular, e.g. ብህለ (to say).

notes: Abstract vowel labels: a=1st order, u=2nd, i=3rd, A=4th, e=5th, I=6th (schwa), o=7th.
